data.one_liner: FlatBuffers library for Dart to read and write binary data using generated code.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart implementation of the FlatBuffers serialization format. It includes a Builder for constructing buffers and generated classes for schema-defined data, enabling efficient cross‑language data exchange.
use_when: You need high‑performance binary serialization compatible with other FlatBuffers implementations
You want to share data structures between Dart and platforms like C++, Java, or JavaScript
avoid_when: You only need simple JSON or text storage
You require a pure Dart solution without a code‑generation step
strengths: Supports custom buffer allocation and various optimizations
weaknesses: Requires running the flatc compiler to generate Dart code
No built‑in higher‑level abstractions like ORM or JSON mapping
data.setup_notes: Install the flatc compiler for your platform and run it against your .fbs schema to generate Dart files; then add the generated files to your project.
